name: Micro case study
definition: Compact card with a customer, their problem, the measured result and a one-line quote, linking to the full story.
bestUse: Mid-page proof that one specific customer like the visitor succeeded.

demo.how: A case study shrunk to one card: who the customer is, what was wrong, one measured result and a short quote, then a link for those who want the full story. Play shows the customer and challenge, then the result, then the quote and link. The customer and figures are invented.
